GENERAL SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Skeletal and Muscular System? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Skeletal and Muscular System.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Skeletal and Muscular System.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Skeletal and Muscular System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Skeletal and Muscular System.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Evolution and Biodiversity? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Evolution and Biodiversity.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Evolution and Biodiversity.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Evolution and Biodiversity.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Evolution and Biodiversity.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Carbon and its Oxides? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Carbon and its Oxides.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Carbon and its Oxides.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Carbon and its Oxides.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Carbon and its Oxides.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon.

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cell division? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cell division.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cell division.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cell division.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cell division.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Polymers? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Polymers.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Polymers.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Polymers.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Polymers.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters.? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Alkanols, Alkanoic Acids and Esters..

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Detergents ● Soapy and soapless detergents ● Preparations of detergents ● Mode o.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Ecosystems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Cell division and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Genetics ● Meaning of terms and concepts in genetics (Deoxyribon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Evolution and Biodiversity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
